lines.en: I cross the ground in silence
My edges keep shivering

lines.zh: 我的影子比我本人还清楚
lines.en: My shadow is clearer than I am
I flicker a step nearer

lines.zh: 我在原地又出现在前面
lines.en: I vanish here and stand there
My outline has gaps in it

lines.zh: 我走过的地方留下噪点
lines.en: I leave static where I pass

lines.zh: 我的脚步和你错开半拍
lines.en: My step lands half a beat off yours
My shadow reaches behind you first
I come on with my head skewed
I hang in place
My borders are not stable
I flicker like a lost signal
My face is not a face for half a second
Even still, I am moving
The air around me frays
I cannot hear you speaking

lines.zh: 我的轮廓慢慢换了个样子
lines.en: My outline slowly becomes something else
My breathing sounds like noise
I wait for the dream to connect

lines.zh: 我的眼睛一直没有定住
lines.en: My eyes never settle

lines.zh: 我脚下的地透出一点光
lines.en: A little light shows under me
My voice lags half a beat behind
I turn to look at you

lines.zh: 你的脸在我眼里有点花
lines.en: Your face blurs in my sight

lines.zh: 我抬起手，边缘散了一点
lines.en: I lift a hand and my edge frays
Can you make out what I say

lines.zh: 我的眼睛在你身上定不住
lines.en: My eyes will not stay on you
I slide half a layer forward
Have you seen me in a dream
My mouth moves before the sound
The shadow behind you moves too
I stop one step from you

lines.zh: 我不确定你是不是真的
lines.en: I am not sure you are real
My shadow flickers on your feet

lines.zh: 你眼里的我有一层描边
lines.en: I have an outline in your eyes
Stare too long and you will reel

lines.zh: 我后退一步，位置还在这
lines.en: I step back, and stay here anyway

lines.zh: 你眨眼时我换了个角度
lines.en: I change angle when you blink
My face keeps changing slightly
You are unsure whether I am there

lines.zh: 我的轮廓有一处没接上
lines.en: One seam does not quite meet
My whole form blurs once
I pull back half a layer
That scattered me wider
I piece myself back together

lines.zh: 我的名字，显示成了乱码。
lines.en: My name renders as garbage.

lines.zh: 我还能立住自己的形状
lines.en: I can still hold my shape
That was nowhere near enough

lines.zh: 我的名字闪了一下，没坏。
lines.en: My name flickered; it is not broken.

lines.zh: 你拿的那东西我看着不对
lines.en: That thing you hold looks wrong
It jumps in my field of view
I do not plan to take this

lines.zh: 那东西在你手里抖成噪点
lines.en: That thing shivers into static in your hand
It is a blur to me
I reach and pass straight through
This does not exist for me
I nudge it out of the way
I wait for it to disappear
You hit me and pass through
You have stirred my edges
I blur and come back
Your hands close on nothing
I gather in front of you again
A watery shudder runs through me
That made me shorter for a moment
You pass out through me
I drift back to my place

lines.zh: 这一下弄乱了你的视线
lines.en: That scrambled your sight

lines.zh: 我在梦里见过另一个我
lines.en: I have seen another me in a dream
We are not on the same plane
She does not speak, only looks

lines.zh: 我们重叠了一下就分开
lines.en: We overlapped once and parted
I cannot recall such things
My memory comes in gaps
I lower my head and my edges fray
Her voice is on another layer
I reach to touch and cannot
I reach and my hand passes through
It blurs in my hand
I put it back as it was
This seems not to belong here
I stare at it and it does not change
I turn away from it
I try to take it a second time
It warps while I look at it
I can make out your outline
I have moved your way
You are on this layer
Your heart skipped a beat
Was that sound you
I am unsure how close to come
I have reached a hand out
One step back, two steps forward
You are alone on this layer
I have fallen in step with you
My shadow touches you first
You never turned around
The place you stand looks hollow
I worry you are not really there
I stay half a step behind
I fold myself into the wall

lines.zh: 我出现在你刚离开的位置
lines.en: I stand where you just were
There are two sets of footsteps
Turn your head, I am still here

lines.zh: 我又把你的视野搅了一下
lines.en: I blur your view once more
I am at your ear
This layer is growing unstable

lines.zh: 你听到的那句话不是我说的
lines.en: That voice was not mine
I wait for you to enter the next layer
I count your blinks
I lower my voice a little

lines.zh: 你听到的那声不是我的
lines.en: That sound you hear is not mine
I fold myself one layer deeper
You keep up faster than I thought
Your steps have started echoing
I bend the light once

lines.zh: 你身后的墙上多了一个我
lines.en: Another me joins the wall behind you
My hand passes through your shoulder

lines.zh: 我的手指抓住你的衣角
lines.en: My fingers catch your coat hem
I press right into you
My shadow presses you down
I push and you sway
My edge passes over your face
You hear a burst of static
I tug your sleeve

lines.zh: 你眼前的画面断了一格
lines.en: A frame drops out of your sight
I am behind you again
I press against your back
I grab and catch nothing
The edges of your vision shake
I catch hold of your shadow
I pass through you again
You hear a second crackle
The air jumps once
I resolve out of the static
My shadow joins the wall first
You see me, then you do not
I arrive from the other side
My outline begins to settle

lines.zh: 墙上多了一道不对的影子
lines.en: A wrong shadow joins the wall

lines.zh: 我站在你刚才站的地方
lines.en: I stand where you were standing

lines.zh: 我没有脚步声，空气先跳了一下。
lines.en: I have no footsteps; the air jumps first.
The view shudders and goes still
I have leaked out of the dream

lines.zh: 你听见一声短促的杂音
lines.en: A short crackle reaches you
I open my eyes slowly

lines.zh: 这个位置本来不是空的
lines.en: This spot was not empty before

lines.zh: 光线在我身上折了一下
lines.en: The light bends once on me
You see two of me
I am suddenly a step nearer
What stands behind me has come too

lines.zh: 墙上的影子比我先转头
lines.en: The shadow on the wall turns its head before I do

lines.zh: 火光穿过我，我只暗了一块
lines.en: The flame passes through and darkens a patch
I scatter on landing
Water thins me out
The blast tears a gap in me

lines.zh: 一支箭从我身上穿过去
lines.en: An arrow passes through me
Magic sets my whole shape shaking

lines.zh: 我不吃东西，只是越来越淡
lines.en: I do not eat, I only thin
Lightning scatters across me

lines.zh: 坠落时我也散得差不多了
lines.en: I am nearly gone as I fall
